notes: Synthetic, from platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors (413 request_too_large: the Messages API takes at most 128 MB; the message is the page's description of it); request_id invented. Not recordable: it needs a body over 128 MB.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap X4: mapAnthropicStatus maps by error type and ignores the HTTP status, so an error type it does not list falls back to 502 upstream_error, which the router retries, fails over and counts against the circuit breaker: a request too large for Anthropic is too large for any retry too
